# adds_netlogon_files (Resource)

Recursively manages the files from `source_path` below NETLOGON. It overwrites only declared files and removes only paths previously recorded in this resource's state. Empty directories are pruned after file deletion; directories containing unrelated files are preserved.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every file under source_path is deployed recursively to NETLOGON/logon.
resource "adds_netlogon_files" "logon_scripts" {
  source_path = "${path.module}/netlogon"
  path        = "logon"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source_path` (String) Local directory on the machine running Terraform. Every regular file below it is uploaded recursively.

### Optional

- `path` (String) Optional relative destination below NETLOGON. Omit to deploy directly into NETLOGON.

### Read-Only

- `content_hash` (String) Fingerprint of source files, recomputed during planning to detect local additions, removals and content changes.
- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for the managed SYSVOL tree.
- `managed_paths` (Set of String) Relative paths currently owned by this resource. Files outside this set are never removed.
